semantics.structural_owner_tf: same as source_tf unless a separate merge/family rule is explicitly confirmed
semantics.display_tf: source structure may be displayed on its own chart plus approved adjacent charts; M15 inherits H1 and does not create its own structure
plan_b_examples: H4 structure -> H4 chart + D1 chart
H1 structure -> H1 chart + H4 chart + M15 chart
M15 chart -> display H1-owned structure; no M15-native structural selection

m15_policy.reason: User audit decision: M15 movement is too abrupt/noisy for stable native TL selection. M15 displays the exact H1-selected family without re-selection.

important: M15 native structure selection is disabled for this policy.
H1 structure is selected once on H1 and copied with identical geometry to H1, H4, and M15.
H4 structure remains visible on H4 and D1; D1 structure remains on D1.
Destination charts never reselect source geometry.
M15 market bars may still be loaded for chart display/cutoff context, but they do not own TL/CH selection.
No trade authority or production NCA_DRAW writeback is allowed.

h1_h4_merge_policy.reason: When turns/adjustments/ranges are broad, H1 and H4 may represent one structural family instead of two separable structures.

visibility_policy.objective: Select one nearest family per enabled source TF. M15 has no native source family and displays the exact H1-selected geometry.
visibility_policy.current_price_metric: Project TL/CH to the latest closed bar of the display timeframe. Distance is zero when price lies inside the channel; otherwise use distance to the nearest channel boundary.
visibility_policy.note: M15 native selection is disabled. H1 is the structural owner for M15 display; no M15 re-selection or fallback is permitted.

preview_isolation.reason: User confirmed this is a drawing-only audit; all non-preview chart objects may be removed for clean visual verification.
preview_isolation.note: Objects created by indicators are chart objects and may also be removed.
